findings.message: PROCESS, not a defect: the independent adversarial review of revision-b06b91fe produced eight findings (no blocking defects) and closing them edited task-owned paths, so the tree no longer matches the sealed revision. Three were real defects in this change: `/devcontainer status` never received the host-run summary (so AC-1's claim and four documents were false), the reverse guard's mapping read sat outside an audit boundary (a Docker failure escaped unrecorded), and a mirror mount was wrongly refused. Also fixed: the picker had no `hasUI` guard, the ledger stored argv verbatim (a credential would have reached the status text), the guard refused the container path its own remedy named, and four documentation errors.

PROCESS, not a defect: the recorded kata adversarial pass on revision-77f7f98e returned one major, four minors and one nit (all fixed in a0b7c14), so the tree no longer matches the sealed revision. The major was the picker being unreachable when the ambiguous workspace was not the only match (it bound an ambiguous selection and answered with a success-shaped message and no target); the minors were the operator notice rendering RAW argv (a bearer token reached the UI while the ledger and audit redacted it), the reverse guard's refusal being audited as an authorized run, the same-path exemption keying on the mount target only, and none of the new wiring being tested.

PROCESS, not a defect: the recorded adversarial pass on revision-18abd4d1 returned six minors and two nits (no major), all fixed in c4a2916 — the guard's refusal lacked command identity, a withheld host attempt was invisible, the container-space exemption swallowed the host path when the container path was an ancestor, `${localWorkspaceFolder}` was not expanded in same-path mounts, the ledger ignored a `none` capture policy, the picker did not name the image, and two claims had no test. Re-sealing so the record matches the tree.

PROCESS, not a defect: the recorded adversarial pass on revision-4b7ba535 returned one major, three minors and one nit (all fixed in 00e40d2) — the withheld-attempt hook was wired to the tool that ignores it instead of the host-exec tool that reads it, the nested exemption exempted the whole host space, `samePathMounts` compared raw strings, the Chinese README kept a duplicate row, and the ledger was process-scoped rather than session-scoped.

PROCESS, not a defect: the recorded adversarial pass on revision-42a78a3b returned ONE major finding and nothing else (all other claims refuted), fixed in d6c19f8 — `selectionFor` took the candidate state from the workspace's primary candidate while the id came from the picker, so choosing a stopped sibling of a running primary recorded `running` and choosing a running sibling of a stopped primary answered `target-stopped`. Re-sealing so the record matches the tree.

PROCESS, not a defect: the verify-node adversarial pass on revision-08fd4eb1 returned one major and one minor (fixed in 1ab2c7f) — the visibility redacted each argv ELEMENT while the audit trail redacts the JOINED command line (so `--password s3cr3t` reached the operator notice verbatim), and a withheld attempt claimed `(audited)` while leaving no audit record. Re-sealing so both node records match the tree.
